messages:
maya: Quick sweep — where are we on onboarding Orchid-7B and MosaicLite for the catalog launch? Need licensing confirmation, perf profiles, and CRs merged. Target canary Fri (internal milestone).

jordan: I own Orchid intake. License looks ok (Apache-2.0 + weights cleared) but legal asked one provenance question. Perf CI ran but I haven't uploaded the final profile yet.

sam: MosaicLite perf done. p95 ~18ms @ seq128 on A500X with int8 quant. Uploaded profile: s3://redwood-model-profiles/mosaiclite/v1.json :thumbsup:

perf-bot: perf-ci results: Orchid-7B baseline -> p50: 6ms token, p95: 28ms token, mem: 12GB, notes: kernel fallback observed on 1/10 nodes. Logs -> https://perf.redwood/internal/1823/orchid-7b

lia: Legal: I've linked the provenance doc in Confluence (see thread). One note: training dataset clause for Orchid needs explicit attribution in model manifest. @jordan can you add that to the manifest?

jordan: Yep, I'll add dataset attribution to the manifest tonight. Also two small catalog PR comments remain on #455 that block merge.

maya: Who can take the catalog PR review? If we don't clear that, catalog entry won't make the canary cut. :eyes:

alex: I'm free — will review #455 in the next hour and ping back.

devex: Quick heads-up: catalog UI needs the new fields (dataset_attribution, license_url) — I can patch before canary but prefer the manifest to be final so we don't do a hotfix.

perf-ops: Infra note — quantized kernels require kernel v5.18+ on some us-west-2 A500X hosts. We have 10 instances pending kernel update, ETA Fri 09:00 PT. If that slips, we may see degraded p95s in dedicated mode.

maya: Ok timeline: if CRs merged + legal sign-off by Thu EOD, we proceed with canary Fri. Otherwise move to next-week launch window. @eng-sre please monitor the kernel updates and flag issues.

eng-sre: Will monitor and post updates in #eng-sre. If any node stays on old kernel beyond Fri 10:00 PT we'll trigger fallback routing to eu-central for canary.

jordan: Manifest updated with dataset_attribution and license_url. Pushed commit and addressed the two PR comments. Waiting on alex review.

alex: Reviewed, left one minor nit about example prompts. Merged after fix.

maya: Thanks everyone — legal, can you mark sign-off when you confirm wording is accurate?

legal-bot: License review complete — sign-off recorded (ticket LIC-1823).

maya: Great. Closing loop: perf profiles uploaded, manifest updated, PR merged, infra update in progress. I'll open the canary rollout doc later today. :rocket:
